title: B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army
description:
B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army

A B.P.R.D.-emblem ring associated with Guillermo del Toro’s 2008 film Hellboy II: The Golden Army. The Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense is the fictional organization employing Hellboy and his supernatural allies. Designed as a wearable piece of movie memorabilia, the ring features the organization’s recognizable insignia.

COLLECTOR-REPORTED SPECIFICATIONS (not yet independently confirmed for this exact ring)
Manufacturer: Gentle Giant Studios
Material: Base-metal alloy with blue and black enamel detailing
Design: Reported as a 1:1 replica of the film accessory
Reported sizes: US 10, 11 and 12
Production year and edition size: Not verified

Gentle Giant produced other licensed Hellboy II collectibles, but the available sources do not yet establish the ring’s maker, prop accuracy, materials or size range. Verification against original packaging, an official catalog or a contemporary retailer listing is recommended.
